notes.note: Laird left the game in the second term with an ankle issue and didn't return. Reports are that he will miss 3-4 weeks.
Laird had been a popular trade in for Sinclair but he had his lowest in the last three games. The Crows have a good run home so he should be ok.
Laird was a popular replacement for Roberts and didn't disappoint with his 26 disposals and 10 marks. A handy pick up if you got him.
Laird injured a calf early in the game but did finish it out. He will miss 1 to 2 weeks.
